PRD-001Implemented

Product family, borrower segment, amount, tenor, and currency

Core · Compliance OS · Owner: Product Policy

Acceptance boundary

Product family, borrower segment, amount, tenor, and currency is accepted when tenant-scoped execution fails closed on invalid authority or evidence, retains auditable lineage, and the cited automated control-family tests pass.

Current maturity and gap

Executable first-party controls and automated evidence exist for PRD-001; production operation still depends on institution configuration and monitored deployment.
